# AI Agents for Sales Operations — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Design lead-qualification and enrichment agents
- Integrate AI with CRM safely
- Measure pipeline impact

## The sentences to remember

1. **Which sales workflows suit an agent? Rank them** — “Automate what is frequent, rule-like and reversible. Anything you cannot undo keeps a human on the button.”
2. **A lead-qualification agent with tools, scopes and an approval gate** — “Start read-only. Earn write access one tool at a time, with a person on the gate.”
3. **Measuring and governing the agent** — “Qualified leads is the agent's number. Meetings booked is yours. Govern on yours.”
